content: OpenTelemetry official guidance says W3C TraceContext propagates causal trace context across process and network boundaries and manual inject/extract is required for carriers without native instrumentation. Logs can correlate through trace and span IDs. Baggage has no built-in integrity and can leak to third parties, so sensitive or authorization-bearing tenant data must not rely on baggage. Oblivious should persist business identities in domain records and outbox envelopes while using sanitized trace context for telemetry correlation.
